correctness.rationale: Conditioning on a specified fixed point leaves all other images uniformly permuted. The exact three-case conditional rank calculation proves the complete cross-covariance kernel, whose telescoping row sums yield the binomial-reciprocal conditional mean. Binomial unimodality proves the n>=5 sign dichotomy; endpoint reciprocal sums yield Cov(F,R)=2/n^2+O(n^-3). The standalone exact-rational verifier checks every permutation through n=8, 46232 objects and 10325 assertions, plus symbolic sign and row-sum checks through 100. Finite experiments do not extend proof range.

value.rationale: Position-resolved conditioning on a fixed point in a uniformly random permutation is a natural perturbation of a classical record process, prompted by recent fixed-point-dependent record limit theory. The exact signed U-shaped location profile, reflection symmetry despite directional records, and cancellation to a positive O(n^-2) total covariance are non-obvious structural facts and useful finite-n cross-moment information, not only restated marginals.
